title: France weighs emergency measures after protests, Times Now reports
excerpt: Times Now reports that French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu raised the possibility of a state of emergency and supported localised curfews.
author: LokkeeVerse Editorial
content:
French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu warned that a state of emergency was possible and backed localised curfews following violent protests, according to metadata supplied for a Times Now report.

The source description says protests and looting affected thousands of businesses. The headline also reports that 2,500 people were held, but the supplied material gives no further details about those detentions.

The metadata describes a possible emergency declaration, not a confirmed decision to impose one.

**Human verification required:** Confirm the official’s identity and position, the reported remarks, the detention figure and the scale of the impact on businesses before publication.
